title: Witness burns as blue-shifted light from a warp bubble

tellings.quote: well, that sounds like visible band light being blue shifted into the ultraviolet and you're getting literally a sunburn.

plain: Some witnesses who came close to an unexplained craft are said to have been burned, and a former US intelligence officer named David Grusch offers Michels an explanation from physics. A "warp bubble" is a proposed pocket of bent space and time around a craft, and Grusch, reasoning about a case someone described to him, says it "sounds like visible band light being blue shifted into the ultraviolet," so that ordinary light is squeezed into harmful ultraviolet and "you're getting literally a sunburn." If true, the burns would be a clue to how such craft move.
